title: Warmly Charred Ethiopian Lentil Pasta
description: A romantic Ethiopian dish featuring charred lentils and a colatura pasta water emulsion, perfect for a vegetarian dinner
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the chopped onion
Cook the onion for 5 minutes, or until it is translucent and starting to caramelize
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant
Stir in the berbere spice, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute
Add the lentils to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes, or until they are lightly charred
Stir in the colatura and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed
Drain the pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the lentil mixture
Stir in some of the pasta water to create a creamy emulsion
Season with salt and black pepper to taste, then garnish with chopped parsley
